conf.description: insider-threat-uam, activity-alert, syslog-cef: parses ITM's ArcSight CEF export (400-series) via regex (no verified live conf shape exists for the cef function, so header+extensions are extracted with order-independent regex_extract), resolves the undocumented cs1..cs6 slots by cs*Label keyword content per recommendations.direct.cribl, and applies the same ECS corrections and redaction as the json feed.

conf.comment: insider-threat-uam / activity-alert / syslog-cef. ITM ArcSight CEF export (400-series Activity Alerts), ObserveIT/ITM exemplar. Same UAM record as the json feed, CEF-rendered; cs*Label slots resolved by content keyword at parse time, never by position.

functions.description: resolve the undocumented cs1..cs6 slots by reading each cs*Label pair's text at parse time (never by position, per parsing.notes) - a cs*Label whose text matches none of the known keywords (e.g. a window-title label) is deliberately never assigned, which drops it
drop the intermediate extension blob and raw cs slots once resolved, plus _raw (the unredacted CEF line, including any window-title cs value, must not persist)
CEF rt is the event time (epoch-ms or CEF date string); never target @timestamp directly
same event.dataset as the json feed - both formats carry the same dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
